text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has overturned the fate
Parcae
predicted for her and made it
safely through her
first three years.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's left such a strong impression that
people
refer to this time as the Air
Shakur era.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it is.
...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As usual, she's spent a lot of time
thinking today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But some things have changed. All
around us...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the time's gone up! Moirai is
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Okay, we still need to tweak your
training a little.
Let's input today's
training data into Moirai.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Keep your voice down. Someone's
gonna hear you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the Arima Kinen, Air Shakur
suddenly
decided to make part of
Parcae freely accessible
online.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It rocked the Umamusume world,
upending
everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, everyone had access to race

simulations and a perfect comprehensive
training
program catered to each
individual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the program was released

anonymously. The academy has been
searching
high and low for the
programmer who brought
about such an
immense contribution to the

Umamusume racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although it hasn't been confirmed, those
with
keen intuition have put two and two
together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Every damn day... Will you stop,
already? I said it
wasn't me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... My apologies. However, that is
not what I
wish to speak with you about
today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
While I do suspect you to be the true
creator,
let's imagine for a moment that
Moirai was
created by some unknown
benefactor. What do
you think his
intentions were?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why did this anonymous figure release
Moirai?
What was his goal? I can hardly
believe it was
simply from the goodness
of his heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
He probably wanted to collect data for
free.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's what I initially thought as
well.
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All of the students are seeing immense
growth
thanks to Moirai.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's nothing more than a
comprehensive
support system. It
constantly seeks the thoughts
and
judgement of the users.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If the creator's goal was merely data
collection,
there would be no reason to
program it in that
way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the creator of Moirai had a...
greater
vision in mind. What do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How should I know?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur suddenly falls silent, and
doesn't say
anything more after that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Take a guess at what I was gonna say.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That was fast.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Eh, I guess you're not entirely wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have any goal or vision or
whatever. It's
just...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in being at the top of a
bunch of
fake losers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The better the people who come after
me are, the
more reason there is for me
to stick around.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In every generation, the strongest always
rise to
the top.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Obviously. Anyone could see that, and you're just realizing it now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to learn everything about
her. That
applies to everyone.
However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Enough pointless chitchat. The next race
is
coming up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's get training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to continue to watch over her.
After all,
I've got all time in the world.
